description: Render a presentation variant to a PDF (one slide per 16:9 page) via the tenant's browser service, store it as a document on the presentation, and check each slide for overflow (too much text / too many bullets). Required: presentation_id and either variant_id or language. Returns { document_id, slide_count, warnings, overflow:[{position, ok, befund?}] }. Needs a browser service under Integrations (provider 'browser'). View with get_document_link, share with share_presentation.
name: render_presentation
